title: HR Manager (Munich, Germany) /人力资源经理（德国慕尼黑）
body: HR Manager, Germany (Munich) | 人力资源经理（德国慕尼黑） Company: QCraft (轻舟智航) Location: Munich, Germany | 德国慕尼黑 Employment Type: Full-time | 全职 Remote: Not available | 不接受远程 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ About QCraft | 关于轻舟智航 QCraft is a globally leading autonomous driving solutions provider. In 2026, we closed a $100M Series D funding round and established our European headquarters in Munich, Germany. With over 1 million ADAS units deployed and strategic partnerships with Qualcomm, QCraft is accelerating its global expansion. 轻舟智航是全球领先的自动驾驶解决方案提供商。2026年D轮1亿美元融资完成，欧洲总部正式落户德国慕尼黑。辅助驾驶量产超100万台，与高通深度合作，正加速欧洲及全球市场布局。 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Key Responsibilities | 核心职责 • Lead end-to-end HR operations across Germany and Europe — onboarding, payroll, compliance, employee relations. • Design and execute talent acquisition strategies for technical roles (algorithms, engineering, testing) in Europe. • Ensure compliance with German labor law (BGB, Arbeitsrecht) and GDPR. • Drive cross-cultural integration between China HQ and European team. • Partner with business leaders as a strategic HRBP. • Conduct market benchmarking on compensation & employer branding in Europe. • 主导德国及欧洲HR全模块运营（入职、薪资、合规、员工关系）。 • 设计并执行欧洲技术人才招聘战略（算法、工程、测试岗位）。 • 确保符合德国劳动法（BGB、Arbeitsrecht）和GDPR。 • 推动中国总部与欧洲团队的跨文化融合。 • 作为战略HRBP与业务管理层协同。 • 开展欧洲市场薪酬对标与雇主品牌建设。 Requirements | 任职要求 ✅ Education: Bachelor's degree+ (HR, Business Admin, Psychology preferred) ✅ Experience: 8+ years HR management , with 2-3+ years in Europe/Germany ✅ Language: Chinese — Native | German — C1+ | English — Business fluent (preferred) ✅ Knowledge: German/EU labor law, GDPR, payroll, social security, visa processes ✅ Skills: Cross-cultural communication, stakeholder management, hands-on executor ✅ Bonus: Automotive / autonomous driving / tech background; Chinese company overseas experience ✅ 教育背景：本科及以上（人力资源、工商管理、心理学优先） ✅ 经验：8年以上HR管理，其中2-3年以上欧洲/德国经验 ✅ 语言：中文母语 | 德语C1+ | 英语商务流利（加分） ✅ 知识：德国/欧盟劳动法、GDPR、薪资社保、签证流程 ✅ 能力：跨文化沟通、 stakeholder管理、落地执行 ✅ 加分：汽车/智驾/科技背景；中国企业出海经验
